core_message: Align high-energy directions with group-shared modes, represent shared levels through affine offsets, and deploy the calibrated rotations at residual, value and down-projection-input sites.
reference_policy: Preserve the supplied PPT's backbone, three cards, two expansion panels, compact legend and palette; repair mathematical topology and whitespace.
source_basis: User's checked requirements and four named implementation files. The user explicitly authorized GitHub and the local nar directory as the scientific authority.
backend: Python; native PowerPoint shapes and text. LibreOffice renders the actual PPT, and PyMuPDF scales its vector PDF and inspects the render.
panel_roles: Construct: spectral directions and ordered factorization
Represent: shared level plus within-group variation with translation-invariant range
FFN: SwiGLU folding and online structured transform
scientific_guards: R = H_g D Pi G in column convention
R2 shared across KV heads within each layer
K after RoPE, channel-wise cache; V token-wise cache
SiLU only on gate; gate Pi, up D Pi
G4 prime uses conjugated W prime, Y prime
Online operator order is mathematical, not one launch per box
schematic_data: Native scatter and bars are conceptual illustrative marks, not measured experimental observations. Bars use equal vertical scale and preserve max-minus-min under translation.
alignment_exemption: Unequal card and module widths are explicitly requested; top/bottom edges and title anchors must match within each row.
